input.quote: Throughout the Term of this Agreement, M&I shall maintain at all times at its own cost and expense:
input.rationale: Section 14.1 requires M&I to carry commercial general liability, fidelity ($10,000,000), workers' compensation with $500,000 employer's liability, and all-risk property cover, with certificates of insurance delivered at Customer's request (p0217). Workers' compensation and certificates-on-request therefore already meet the preferred position. However, M&I is a data processing/hosting vendor handling our customer data and the clause contains no professional liability (E&O) and no cyber/privacy liability coverage; fidelity insurance covers employee dishonesty only and is no substitute. The clause consequently fails the fallback (E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M) on a material term. We therefore added E&O at $2,000,000 and cyber/privacy at $5,000,000 as new items 5 and 6, and fixed the general liability limits at $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate, which the existing item 1 left unstated.

ops.text: Such limits shall be not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence and two million dollars ($2,000,000) in the aggregate.
Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance covering the Services, in an amount not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000).
Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance covering unauthorized access to, or loss or disclosure of, Customer Data, in an amount not less than five million dollars ($5,000,000).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We fixed the general liability limits at $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate, and added professional liability (E&O) of $2,000,000 and cyber/privacy liability of $5,000,000 because M&I processes our customer data. This is our standard vendor insurance position.
proposal.summary: Add CGL per-occurrence/aggregate limits and professional liability (E&O) and cyber liability coverage to M&I's insurance obligations

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2M.
Cyber and privacy insurance of USD 5M for vendors processing Customer Data.
Workers' compensation as required by law.
